questions.stemHtml: An ophthalmic image reveals multiple shallow depressions near the limbus, located in the superior part of the cornea, just beneath the upper eyelid. Based on this image finding alone, which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Episcleral vessel inflammation without scleral involvement

options.label: B
options.text: Fibrovascular conjunctival growth encroaching onto the cornea

options.label: D
options.text: Deep scleral inflammation extending beyond conjunctiva
